description: Kept her footing, and saw the woman at the edge.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Worked the boat at the near edge of the show.
name: Davy Gannet

description: Saw the sword go first and said Sir John had kept his own door.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Stood at the back of his own company. He did not look at the stair, and he did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Turned away, laughing, and was not named.
name: the lady of the parish

description: Came for the drums and took his hat off toward Bishopsgate.
name: Will Kemp

description: Wrote the one line and did not sit to eat.
name: William Shakespeare
